fluff.overview: Heavy laser jump platoons carry extended-range Sunbeam Starfire laser rifles and King David light gauss support weapons, combining jump mobility with unusually heavy firepower for an infantry formation. The ER lasers provide accurate long-range energy fire, while the light gauss weapons deliver armor-penetrating projectiles without chemical propellant. This loadout gives the platoon credible anti-vehicle capability from elevated jump positions, though the weight of the support weapons limits sustained jumping.
